mcp_arguments.question: CPU scene preparation task graph: remove allocator contention and temporary container copies, start ready work before independent owner work, and minimize work stealing critical path without per-item task overhead
mcp_arguments.context: MaterialGraphScenePrepare: draw binding work already overlaps geometry preparation. Camera visibility currently begins after DrawsPrepare and geometry publication although its immutable meshlet input is available earlier. Each view prepares 8 or more meshlet lists; temporary candidate/bin vectors are copied into frame storage and generic validation creates unused per-bin vectors. Compare exact production bodies and allocation counts, do not predict GPU or total frame speedup from microbenchmarks.
